instructions:
1. Sit at a preacher bench and rest the back of your left upper arm flat on the pad, twisting your torso slightly to the right.
2. Hold a dumbbell in your left hand with an underhand grip, arm hanging straight down.
3. Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder by bending your elbow, keeping your upper arm pressed to the pad.
4. Squeeze the biceps at the top.
5. Lower the dumbbell under control until your arm is fully extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your upper arm flat against the pad to isolate the biceps.
2. Do not use momentum; move slowly and with control.
3. Use a full range of motion at the bottom and top.
4. Keep your wrist straight and aligned with your forearm.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding one dumbbell with both hands at your chest.
2. Bend your knees and hips to lower into a squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
3. At the bottom, press the dumbbell forward to full arm extension, then bring it back to your chest.
4. Push through your heels to stand back up.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your knees tracking over your toes and do not let them cave inward.
2. Press the dumbbell in a straight line at chest height.
3. Brace your core throughout the movement.
4. Keep your chest up and back flat in the squat.

instructions:
1. Lie flat on a bench with feet planted on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
2. Extend your arms so the dumbbells are above and slightly behind your head, upper arms angled about 45 degrees.
3. Keeping your elbows fixed, bend your arms to lower the dumbbells behind your head.
4. Extend your elbows to press the dumbbells back up to full arm extension.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move only your forearms; keep your upper arms still.
2. Keep your elbows tucked and pointing forward.
3. Lower the weight under control and do not swing.
4. Use a weight you can fully extend with good form.

instructions:
1. Set an incline bench to about 45 degrees and lie chest first against the pad.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with arms hanging straight down and palms facing forward.
3. Keeping your upper arms still, curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders.
4. Squeeze the biceps at the top.
5. Lower the dumbbells under control until your arms are fully extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly and with control to maximize biceps tension.
2. Keep your wrists straight and aligned with your forearms.
3. Do not swing the weights or lift your chest off the pad.
4. Let your arms fully extend at the bottom for a full stretch.

instructions:
1. Set an incline bench to about 45 degrees and lie chest first against the pad.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with arms hanging straight down and palms facing each other.
3. Keeping your upper arms still, curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders with a neutral grip.
4. Squeeze at the top.
5. Lower the dumbbells under control until your arms are fully extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your palms facing each other through the whole movement.
2. Move slowly and with control.
3. Do not swing the weights or lift your chest off the pad.
4. Keep your wrists straight and firm.
